items.title: 3 US Consumer Staples Stocks Built For Sticky Inflation
items.summary: Inflation is proving sticky, with October PCE running at 3.8% year-on-year and markets bracing for higher rates for longer, so simply hiding in cash may not feel comfortable. Persistent price pressure can reward businesses that keep shoppers coming back while managing their own costs, and punish those that cannot. This article walks through three US consumer staples stocks exposed to this backdrop and explains why each might deserve a closer look now. The stocks covered next are only a sample...

items.title: Here’s How Many Coca-Cola Shares It Takes to Earn $1,300 Every Quarter in Dividends
items.summary: You would need to own more than 2,450 shares of Coca-Cola to generate $1,300 in dividend income.

items.title: Coca-Cola Has Raised Its Dividend 64 Straight Years. Here's What $10,000 Will Pay You in 2027.
items.summary: This Dividend King pays investors reliably, but its stock price has run ahead of the business.

items.title: How Much You’d Need in Dividend Stocks to Generate $5,000 a Month in Passive Income
items.summary: The price tag on a $60,000 dividend paycheck swings by nearly $2 million depending on the yield you chase. Higher payouts shrink the bill, but one tier hides a trap that can gut your income when a cut arrives.

items.title: Leaving a Roth IRA to Your Kids? Why Dividend Stocks Make the 10-Year Rule Work for Them
items.summary: One stock in a six-pack of blue-chip dividend payers drives nearly two-fifths of the tax bill on an inherited portfolio, and it belongs somewhere else entirely. Your kids could pay for that mistake for decades.

items.title: Corporate Bonds vs. Dividend Stocks: Which Pays a Retiree More Reliably?
items.summary: Corporate bond yields just hit a 12-month high, yet that fat payout hides trade-offs in price risk, reinvestment, and taxes. For retirees weighing bonds against Procter & Gamble and Coca-Cola, the tax bill may decide the winner.

items.title: Coca-Cola Consolidated (COKE) Stock Is Up 5.9% Today Without Company News
